description: This file contains a shell script defining a function to set MAC addresses based on board-specific configuration and registering this function to execute during the pre-initialization stage.

methods.name: preinit_set_mac_address
methods.description: Sets the MAC addresses for LAN and WAN interfaces based on board configuration.

calls: ip link set dev eth0 address "${lan_mac}"
ip link set dev eth1 address "${wan_mac}"
